Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-resolution portrait atlas for an offline Japanese high school wind ensemble game.
Reference image: the attached image is ONLY a reference for the existing delicate ink-and-soft-paint illustration style, navy school uniforms, ivory background, and youthful first-year age. Create NEW identities. Improve refinement and attractiveness substantially.
Primary request: EXACTLY TWELVE fictional Japanese teen classmates, about 15 years old, nine beautiful girls and three handsome boys. Wholesome school portrait headshots, naturally attractive, fresh and endearing rather than adult glamour. Fine clean contours, luminous natural eyes, tidy brows, smooth nuanced skin shading, lovely natural smiles. Preserve individual face shapes and eyes, do not clone the same face with new hair. All look the same youthful age, soft short chins and gentle cheeks. No makeup, no adult styling, no sexualization.
Composition: perfectly regular FOUR columns by THREE rows of SQUARE cells; 4:3 landscape canvas, ideally 2048x1536 or higher, every cell equally sized. Each head centered, full hair silhouette inside frame, consistent head scale, upper chest visible. Nearly front facing. Flat warm ivory background in every cell. NO borders, gutters, text, numbers, instruments or watermark.
Style: polished contemporary Japanese narrative-game character art; crisp expressive small details and smooth painterly color, NOT vector, NOT stippled, NOT pixelated, NOT coarse watercolor, NOT photographic, NOT chibi.
Casting order left to right top to bottom:
1 girl: sweet rounded oval, wide-set almond eyes, long dark straight hair and wispy fringe, soft smile.
2 girl: softly heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, chin-length bob tucked behind one ear.
3 girl: soft square face, gently upturned slim eyes, high ponytail and airy side fringe, confident kind smile.
4 girl: plump soft cheeks, gentle downturned eyes, low side braid, thoughtful small smile.
5 girl: petite short oval face, lively almond eyes, short pixie haircut that still reads clearly as a girl.
6 girl: narrow rounded face, bright eyes behind delicate round glasses, long loose hair and light bangs.
7 girl: broad soft oval, slightly hooded eyes, shoulder length wavy hair, warm open expression.
8 girl: short heart face, separated bangs, long low twin ponytails, small dimpled closed smile.
9 girl: compact oval, fine long eyes, long hair pinned to the side with one small hairpin, calm graceful expression.
10 boy: attractive soft oval face, clear gentle masculine eyes and fine straight brows, fluffy side-parted short hair, slim youthful neck, kind smile.
11 boy: attractive softly square youthful face, bright slightly upturned eyes, neat dark cropped hair and soft fringe, fresh friendly smile.
12 boy: attractive short oval face, lively rounded eyes, loose natural dark waves and thin oval glasses, gentle playful closed smile.
Girls wear modest navy blazer, white shirt, small navy ribbon; boys navy blazer, white shirt, narrow navy tie. Keep every face appealing, clearly distinct and age-appropriate. Hair black or natural dark brown, realistic variety of complexion. The result must remain sharp when one cell is displayed at 112 CSS pixels on a 3x-density iPhone.
